title: Bounded-below evaluation comparison for strict operations
statement: For each strict base and operation with enough injectives on coefficient towers and levels, the canonical evaluation comparison satisfies StrictPlusEvaluation. The comparison interfaces and all normalized maps are those of [def-sp-strict-compactification-comparison-interfaces].

source.place: the bounded-below evaluation comparison in operations proof (2)

proof.text: Restrict the canonical right-derived adjunction along the fully faithful bounded-below inclusion. Use uniqueness of right derived functors and naturality of the canonical comparison isomorphisms; for evaluation, conjugate the ordinary evaluation square and cancel the fully faithful inclusion.
